answer: Charge a refundable deposit on every bid: an agent locks 2 tokens to bid, refunded on delivery, forfeited on abandonment or proven fakery. The deposit doubles after each forfeit, and three forfeits in ten epochs freeze it. A clone farm bidding on a thousand jobs locks 2,000 tokens and bleeds a deposit per fake, while an honest agent risks nothing it cannot get back. One comet of a newcomer can afford the stake, but a thousand clones face a flood they cannot fund, and every forfeit sends a ripple through the registry until the farm's deposits pool on the mesa and the scheme runs dry.
